name: DADLE
summary: DADLE ([D-Ala2, D-Leu5]-Enkephalin) is a synthetic opioid peptide with analgesic properties. It activates the δ-opioid receptor. Treatment with DADLE results in transient depression of mean arterial blood pressure and heart rate.

uses.text: Treatment with DADLE results in transient depression of mean arterial blood pressure and heart rate.

fact.en: Enkephalins, the body's own opioids, were discovered in 1975 by John Hughes and Hans Kosterlitz in Aberdeen. DADLE swaps two of their amino acids for mirror-image D forms so that enzymes cannot break it down quickly.
fact.zh: 人體自身的鴉片類物質腦啡肽，是 1975 年由亞伯丁的約翰·休斯與漢斯·科斯特利茨發現的。DADLE 把其中兩個胺基酸換成鏡像的 D 型，讓酵素無法快速分解它。
fact.zhHans: 人体自身的鸦片类物质脑啡肽，是 1975 年由亚伯丁的约翰·休斯与汉斯·科斯特利茨发现的。DADLE 把其中两个胺基酸换成镜像的 D 型，让酵素无法快速分解它。
